info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Deliverys-v3-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Delivery API allows users to retrieve a list of prescriptions scheduled for delivery. This API is designed for pharmacy applications and healthcare providers to efficiently manage and track prescription deliveries. Developers can access real-time data about deliveries, including status and timelines, which is essential for effective patient care coordination. Typical consumers include pharmacy management systems and healthcare applications seeking to enhance their service offerings and improve medication adherence.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details regarding the delivery status and information of their prescriptions. It provides essential insights that assist in tracking and managing prescription deliveries efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving prescription delivery information. This request allows clients to obtain detailed data regarding the delivery status of prescriptions.

204.description: Request completed successfully without any content.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsDeliverysReques.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the prescriptions delivery endpoint. It is expected to be a string that contains the relevant information regarding the delivery request.
